meta.name: Fold-Along
meta.description: A paper boat in nine steps. The film stops after every step and waits until you have folded it: watch the step again, or go on. A paired phone beside your paper shows the steps and a tip for each.
meta.creator: demo

chapters.title: 6. Open the hat into a square

frametrail:attributes.text: <p><span style="font-size: 17px; letter-spacing: 2px; color: #e2583e;"><strong>WHAT YOU NEED</strong></span></p><p><span style="font-size: 32px;"><strong>A paper boat</strong></span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 17px; letter-spacing: 2px; color: #e2583e;"><strong>STEP 1 OF 9</strong></span></p><p><span style="font-size: 32px;"><strong>Fold in half</strong></span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 17px; letter-spacing: 2px; color: #e2583e;"><strong>STEP 2 OF 9</strong></span></p><p><span style="font-size: 32px;"><strong>Mark the middle</strong></span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 17px; letter-spacing: 2px; color: #e2583e;"><strong>STEP 3 OF 9</strong></span></p><p><span style="font-size: 32px;"><strong>Corners to the middle</strong></span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 17px; letter-spacing: 2px; color: #e2583e;"><strong>STEP 4 OF 9</strong></span></p><p><span style="font-size: 32px;"><strong>First strip up</strong></span></p>

body.frametrail:name: Step: Turn over, second strip up

frametrail:attributes.text: <p><span style="font-size: 17px; letter-spacing: 2px; color: #e2583e;"><strong>STEP 5 OF 9</strong></span></p><p><span style="font-size: 32px;"><strong>Turn over, second strip up</strong></span></p>

body.frametrail:name: Step: Open the hat into a square

frametrail:attributes.text: <p><span style="font-size: 17px; letter-spacing: 2px; color: #e2583e;"><strong>STEP 6 OF 9</strong></span></p><p><span style="font-size: 32px;"><strong>Open the hat into a square</strong></span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 17px; letter-spacing: 2px; color: #e2583e;"><strong>STEP 7 OF 9</strong></span></p><p><span style="font-size: 32px;"><strong>Bottom corners up</strong></span></p>

body.frametrail:name: Step: Open into a smaller square

frametrail:attributes.text: <p><span style="font-size: 17px; letter-spacing: 2px; color: #e2583e;"><strong>STEP 8 OF 9</strong></span></p><p><span style="font-size: 32px;"><strong>Open into a smaller square</strong></span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 17px; letter-spacing: 2px; color: #e2583e;"><strong>STEP 9 OF 9</strong></span></p><p><span style="font-size: 32px;"><strong>Pull the points apart</strong></span></p>
